purpose: Form CRA-3 is the form of the cost audit report used by a cost auditor to report on the cost records examined and cost statements prepared as per the rules.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Appoint the cost auditor under sub-section (3) of section 148 of the Act.
Audit the cost records maintained under section 148 of the Act in compliance with cost auditing standards.
Examine information, statements, and observations for the cost audit report.
Prepare the cost audit report as per Form CRA-3 including the annexure, qualifications, or observations.
checklist: Registered office address of the company
Information and explanations necessary for the audit
Cost records maintained as per rule 5
Books and records giving required information
System of internal audit of cost records
Unit of Measurement for each Customs Tariff Act Heading
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
